Form 4797, Form 6252, Schedule K-1, Form 2439 and Form 1099-R sources and prior-year carryovers are refused before this worksheet is used: `sd.count` refuses on `sd.other_forms` ("Are there gains/losses from Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781, 8824 or Schedule K-1?") and on `sd.carryover` ("Is there a capital loss carryover from the prior year?"), and that refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through Schedule D lines 7, 15 and 16, so no return with those items is prepared. Lines 1–10, 12 and 16 are therefore zero, line 11 is Form 1099-DIV box 2b alone, and line 17 combines a non-negative line 14, a line 15 carried as a negative number (i1040sd p. 13, line 15: "Enter the (loss), if any, from Schedule D, line 7. If Schedule D, line 7, is zero or a gain, enter -0-") and a zero line 16, so "Combine lines 14 through 16. If the result is a (loss), enter it as a positive amount. If the result is zero or a gain, enter -0-" is the floored negation encoded. A positive carryover on line 16 must be subtracted when carryovers come into scope (recorded in the transcription rulings). No change to the data.
